title: Sparse bounds for rough non-translation-invariant Calderón-Zygmund operators
summary: In this paper, we establish sparse bounds for singular integral operators with rough non-translation-invariant Calderón-Zygmund kernels. Our approach verifies the localized hypothesis in the sparse domination framework introduced by Conde-Alonso, Di Plinio et al. The proof refines Seeger's microlocal decomposition using a Littlewood-Paley analysis adapted to the non-translation-invariant setting. As applications, we obtain quantitative weighted estimates for Calderón-type commutators and other singular integrals with rough kernels.
